scope: Append-only ideal-PSD paired-shell descriptive relaxation on the unchanged canonical 16 voxels; zero fitting, regrading, exclusions or domain/tolerance changes
pairing: Exactly one-to-one equal released float64 vectors across b1000 and b2000; preserve source order within b1000, carry explicit source volume indices; fail closed for unmatched or duplicate vectors. No angular tolerance, antipodal substitution or normalization
calculation: Per-pair max(0,y_b2000-y_b1000)^2/2; sum over all 64 pairs then divide by measured canonical b0 squared and 129, unchanged two-shell mean-SSE denominator. Ignore b0 residual and other shared model constraints only as a relaxation
release_boundary: Exploratory descriptive necessary-condition calculation for an ideal mathematical PSD model only, not a certified operational lower bound for the roundoff-tolerant numerical domain. Float64 evaluation is not an interval-arithmetic certificate. Noise can reverse observed shell order. No biological adequacy conclusion, artifact label, noise estimate, loss ceiling, threshold, or hardness claim follows. The scan is the acquisition unit; the selected 16 voxels are not 16 independent participants. No physical-gradient orientation certification, search extension, optimizer or Sol run is authorized
